Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.a1: Bitstart is a platform that empowers entrepreneurs by giving them the right resources to present their startups.
Faq.a2: Anyone with an innovative idea and a passion for entrepreneurship can join our platform.
Faq.q3: How do investors benefit from Equits?
Faq.a3: Investors get access to a curated pipeline of promising startups and talented teams.
Faq.a4: Equits doesn't just connect you with investors - it supports you through mentorship, resources, and tools to help you present your startup effectively and attract funding.

Pitch.title: Pitch Your Project
Pitch.subtitle: Fill in the details to pitch your project.

Basics.projectNamePlaceholder: Enter the official or commercial name of your project
Basics.taglinePlaceholder: A short, catchy sentence that describes your startup in one line
Basics.elevatorPitchPlaceholder: Explain your idea in 5 minutes as if you were in an elevator with an investor.
Basics.youtubeVideoPlaceholder: Provide a YouTube video link that showcases your idea and pitch.
Basics.liveLinkPlaceholder: Provide a link to your live product or prototype (e.g. Figma, website, demo)

Market.valuePropPlaceholder: Why your solution is better or unique.

Traction.dauPlaceholder: Enter Number of Daily Active Users.
Traction.mrrPlaceholder: Total recurring revenue generated every month in USD
Traction.growthRatePctPlaceholder: How fast your use revenue is growing every month.
Traction.retentionRatePlaceholder: Percentage of users who keep using your product over time.
Traction.conversionRatePlaceholder: Percentage of users who become paying customers.

Funding.fundingAskPlaceholder: Enter amount of funding you are currently seeking
Funding.useOfFundsPlaceholder: Briefly explain how you will use the investment.
Funding.businessPlanPlaceholder: Paste a hosted PDF URL if you have one
